response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with strong full-stack, DLang, and systems background, but his recent and overall career history is overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js ecosystems with only minimal, dated exposure to Java and essentially no visible Kotlin, Spring, or IDE tooling experience, making him a poor match for this JVM-focused enterprise IDE role.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across many domains (web, embedded, mobile, systems)
Demonstrated ability to build developer tooling, test frameworks, and CLI/runner projects (Trial, Fluent-Asserts)
Strong communication and teaching skills (workshops, talks, mentoring)
concerns: No evidence of Kotlin experience and only minor, old Java exposure (robotic arms, IDE C/C++ work)
No mention of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise Java frameworks in any role
No direct IDE internals or JVM tooling experience relevant to the specific product domain

key_factors.factor: Strong general software engineering and tooling background
